title: Baloxavir and molnupiravir protect against severe influenza A(H5N1) infection in immunosuppressed hamsters
abstract: Highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) viruses continue to expand their geographic and host range, raising concerns about zoonotic transmission and pandemic preparedness. Immunocompromised individuals often develop severe and prolonged disease, yet evidence guiding antiviral therapy remains limited. Here, we characterized the pathogenesis and assessed direct-contact transmission of an influenza A(H5N1) clade 2.3.4.4b genotype D1.1 virus recently isolated from a human case in British Columbia, Canada, in cyclophosphamide-immunosuppressed hamsters, with normal hamsters included for comparison of infection outcomes and viral shedding kinetics. We also evaluated the antiviral efficacy of oseltamivir (20 mg/kg twice daily for 5 days), baloxavir (50 mg/kg, 2 doses), and molnupiravir (50 or 200 mg/kg twice daily) as monotherapies or in combination (oseltamivir with low-dose molnupiravir) in immunosuppressed hamsters. While normal hamsters showed no mortality and achieved viral clearance, infection in immunosuppressed hamsters caused severe disease characterized by prolonged viral replication, neuroinvasion, and 75% mortality, with no direct-contact transmission detected. In the antiviral efficacy experiment, placebo-treated hamsters exhibited 50% mortality. Baloxavir resulted in 100% survival, shortened viral shedding, reduced viral replication and pulmonary inflammatory responses, and prevented neuroinvasion. High-dose molnupiravir also prevented mortality and achieved viral clearance in lung and brain tissues. Combination therapy resulted in 75% survival and similarly achieved viral clearance in both tissues, with reduced morbidity compared with oseltamivir and low-dose molnupiravir monotherapies. Oseltamivir resulted in 75% survival but failed to prevent severe clinical signs or reduce tissue viral titers, whereas low-dose molnupiravir showed outcomes comparable to placebo. These findings demonstrate the high pathogenicity of a human A(H5N1) isolate in immunosuppressed hamsters, support baloxavir as an effective therapeutic option, and identify molnupiravir-based regimens as promising strategies for severe influenza A(H5N1) infection.

title_zh: Baloxavir 和 molnupiravir 可保护免疫抑制仓鼠免受严重甲型流感 (H5N1) 感染
source_body_en: Highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) viruses continue to expand their geographic and host range, raising concerns about zoonotic transmission and pandemic preparedness. Immunocompromised individuals often develop severe and prolonged disease, yet evidence guiding antiviral therapy remains limited. Here, we characterized the pathogenesis and assessed direct-contact transmission of an influenza A(H5N1) clade 2.3.4.4b genotype D1.1 virus recently isolated from a human case in British Columbia, Canada, in cyclophosphamide-immunosuppressed hamsters, with normal hamsters included for comparison of infection outcomes and viral shedding kinetics. We also evaluated the antiviral efficacy of oseltamivir (20 mg/kg twice daily for 5 days), baloxavir (50 mg/kg, 2 doses), and molnupiravir (50 or 200 mg/kg twice daily) as monotherapies or in combination (oseltamivir with low-dose molnupiravir) in immunosuppressed hamsters. While normal hamsters showed no mortality and achieved viral clearance, infection in immunosuppressed hamsters caused severe disease characterized by prolonged viral replication, neuroinvasion, and 75% mortality, with no direct-contact transmission detected. In the antiviral efficacy experiment, placebo-treated hamsters exhibited 50% mortality. Baloxavir resulted in 100% survival, shortened viral shedding, reduced viral replication and pulmonary inflammatory responses, and prevented neuroinvasion. High-dose molnupiravir also prevented mortality and achieved viral clearance in lung and brain tissues. Combination therapy resulted in 75% survival and similarly achieved viral clearance in both tissues, with reduced morbidity compared with oseltamivir and low-dose molnupiravir monotherapies. Oseltamivir resulted in 75% survival but failed to prevent severe clinical signs or reduce tissue viral titers, whereas low-dose molnupiravir showed outcomes comparable to placebo. These findings demonstrate the high pathogenicity of a human A(H5N1) isolate in immunosuppressed hamsters, support baloxavir as an effective therapeutic option, and identify molnupiravir-based regimens as promising strategies for severe influenza A(H5N1) infection.

title: Immunogenicity and safety of two priming doses of an MF59-adjuvanted cell-based H5N8 influenza vaccine in healthy persons aged ≥18 years
abstract: BACKGROUND: Increased transmission of avian influenza from animals to humans has elevated the risk of an H5 pandemic. METHODS: This phase 2, randomized, observer-blind, multi-center trial assessed the immunogenicity and safety of homologous priming with an MF59-adjuvanted, cell-based H5N8 A/Astrakhan/3212/2020 clade 2.3.4.4b vaccine (aH5N8c). We enrolled adults age ≥18 years, equally stratified into 18-64 (including a poultry-worker subset) and ≥65 year cohorts. Primary and secondary outcomes were homologous antibody responses against H5N8 measured in all participants by hemagglutination inhibition (HI) and in a subset by microneutralization (MN) assays on Days 1, 22, and 43. Solicited adverse events (AEs) were monitored for 7 days post-vaccination, with unsolicited AEs tracked throughout Day 43. RESULTS: 239 participants were vaccinated (18-64 years, n = 121; ≥65 years, n = 118). At Day 43 (21 days post second aH5N8c dose), geometric mean fold increases (GMFI) were 13.7 for the 18-64 cohort and 10.2 for the ≥65 cohort. HI seroconversion rates were 75.8% (95% CI 66.1-83.8%) for the 18-64 cohort and 71.0% (61.1-79.6%) for the ≥65 cohort. HI titers ≥1:40 were achieved in 75.8% (66.1-83.8%) and 73.0% (63.2-81.4%) of participants, respectively. MN seroconversion rates were 80.6% (68.6-89.6%) and 70.0% (56.8-81.2%), while MN titers ≥1:40 were 83.9% (72.3-92.0%) and 86.7% (75.4-94.1%), respectively. No notable differences in immune responses by poultry worker status were observed. Most solicited AEs were mild or moderate, resolving within 3 days. Unsolicited AEs were reported by 16.7% participants by Day 43. CONCLUSION: These data support the use of the MF59-adjuvanted, cell-based monovalent H5N8 vaccine as a public health intervention against H5 influenza.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the immunogenicity and safety of an MF59-adjuvanted cell-based H5N8 vaccine in healthy adults aged ≥18 years. It was a phase 2, randomized, observer-blind, multi-center trial that enrolled participants into two age cohorts, including a poultry-worker subset. The primary outcomes were antibody responses measured by hemagglutination inhibition (HI) and microneutralization (MN) assays, with solicited adverse events monitored for 7 days and unsolicited events tracked up to Day 43. Most adverse events were mild or moderate, and unsolicited events were reported by 16.7% of participants. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 从动物到人类的 传播 增加增加了 H5 大流行的风险。本研究旨在评估健康成人中基于 MF59 佐剂的 H5N8 疫苗 细胞的免疫原性和安全性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项 2 期、随机、观察者盲法、多中心试验评估了 疫苗 在 18 岁以上成人中的免疫原性和安全性,同样分层为 18-64 岁和 ≥65 岁 队列研究,包括家禽工人子集。
elements_zh.methods: 主要和次要结果是在第 1 天、第 22 天和第 43 天通过血凝抑制 (HI) 测量所有参与者的 H5N8 同源抗体反应,并通过微中和 (MN) 测定测量子集。在 疫苗接种 后 7 天监测主动不良事件 (AE),并在整个第 43 天跟踪主动不良事件 (AE)。
elements_zh.main_results: 239 名参与者接种了疫苗(18-64 岁,n = 121;≥65 岁,n = 118)。在第 43 天,18-64 队列研究 的几何平均倍数增加 (GMFI) 为 13.7,≥65 队列研究 的几何平均倍数增加为 10.2。18-64 队列研究 的 HI 血清转化率为 75.8% (95% CI 66.1-83.8%),≥65 队列研究 的 HI 血清转化率为 71.0% (61.1-79.6%)。75.8% (66.1-83.8%) 和 73.0% (63.2-81.4%) 的参与者分别达到 HI 效价≥1:40。MN血清转化率为80.6%(68.6-89.6%)和70.0%(56.8-81.2%),而MN滴度≥1:40分别为83.9%(72.3-92.0%)和86.7%(75.4-94.1%)。没有观察到家禽工人状态的 免疫应答 存在显着差异。大多数请求的 AE 均为轻度或中度,并在 3 天内解决。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究表明,两种启动剂量的 MF59 佐剂的基于细胞的 H5N8 疫苗 在两个年龄组中均诱导出强劲的 免疫应答,且不同家禽工人状态的功效没有显着差异。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为针对 H5N8 流感的 疫苗 的开发和实施提供了重要数据,支持其用作高危人群的公共卫生干预措施。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其关注健康成年人且缺乏长期随访而受到限制。证据是中等的,因为结果是基于单个试验,没有额外的比较数据。

title: Characterising the longer-term impacts of highly pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks prior to 2020 on wild bird populations
abstract: Since 2020, there has been a global escalation of the impacts of highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) on wild bird species. However, the population-level consequences of this disease remain poorly understood, despite repeated outbreaks affecting wild birds over the past two decades. To address this, we collated population counts and mortality data from 40 historical cases where HPAI mass-mortality occurred in wild bird populations prior to 2020. We characterised local impacts of these outbreaks based on i) initial change in population count from the last count pre-outbreak to the first count post-outbreak, ii) longer-term change in average population counts, iii) change in population trend, and iv) time taken to recover to the pre-outbreak baseline. Following outbreaks, initial population count declines were observed in most cases, with a median decrease of 17% (Inter-quartile range −35% to 5%). Yet in the longer-term, significant reductions in average population counts were detected in only eight of the 40 cases, and a significant decrease in population trend in only two cases. Overall, in the majority of local populations, outbreaks resulted in either limited impacts on population counts or short-term reductions followed by recovery. However, in 25% of cases (10/40) initial declines were not recovered within the monitoring period (4–17 years after the initial outbreak). Initial declines were more apparent in gulls and terns; however, impacts were seen in local populations across a range of taxa. Given that the scale of impacts of HPAI has changed dramatically since 2020, our findings support the need for disease surveillance to be combined with effective population monitoring in order to identify species impacted from the ongoing outbreaks. Further research is also needed to identify strategies for minimising impacts of HPAI, and to understand factors limiting recovery in affected populations.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to understand the population-level impacts of highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) on wild bird species prior to 2020, addressing the knowledge gap in the global escalation of HPAI impacts on wild birds over the past two decades.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved collating population counts and mortality data from 40 historical cases of HPAI mass-mortality in wild bird populations prior to 2020, spanning various geographical locations and species.
analysis.methods: Population counts and mortality data were collected from historical cases of HPAI in wild birds, and changes in population counts and trends were characterized based on initial and longer-term impacts post-outbreak.
analysis.main_results: Initial population count declines were observed in most cases, with a median decrease of 17% (Inter-quartile range −35% to 5%), but significant reductions in average population counts were detected in only eight of the 40 cases, and a significant decrease in population trend in only two cases.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that while initial declines were common, longer-term impacts were limited, with most populations recovering or showing no significant change, highlighting the need for ongoing surveillance and monitoring.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study supports the need for disease surveillance combined with effective population monitoring to identify species impacted by ongoing HPAI outbreaks and to develop strategies to minimize impacts and understand factors limiting recovery.

title_zh: 描述 2020 年之前 高致病性禽流感 暴发 对 野生鸟类 人群的长期影响
source_body_en: Since 2020, there has been a global escalation of the impacts of highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) on wild bird species. However, the population-level consequences of this disease remain poorly understood, despite repeated outbreaks affecting wild birds over the past two decades. To address this, we collated population counts and mortality data from 40 historical cases where HPAI mass-mortality occurred in wild bird populations prior to 2020. We characterised local impacts of these outbreaks based on i) initial change in population count from the last count pre-outbreak to the first count post-outbreak, ii) longer-term change in average population counts, iii) change in population trend, and iv) time taken to recover to the pre-outbreak baseline. Following outbreaks, initial population count declines were observed in most cases, with a median decrease of 17% (Inter-quartile range −35% to 5%). Yet in the longer-term, significant reductions in average population counts were detected in only eight of the 40 cases, and a significant decrease in population trend in only two cases. Overall, in the majority of local populations, outbreaks resulted in either limited impacts on population counts or short-term reductions followed by recovery. However, in 25% of cases (10/40) initial declines were not recovered within the monitoring period (4–17 years after the initial outbreak). Initial declines were more apparent in gulls and terns; however, impacts were seen in local populations across a range of taxa. Given that the scale of impacts of HPAI has changed dramatically since 2020, our findings support the need for disease surveillance to be combined with effective population monitoring in order to identify species impacted from the ongoing outbreaks. Further research is also needed to identify strategies for minimising impacts of HPAI, and to understand factors limiting recovery in affected populations.
abstract_zh: 自 2020 年以来,高致病性禽流感 (HPAI) 对 野生鸟类 物种的影响在全球范围内不断升级。然而,尽管 暴发 在过去二十年中反复影响 野生鸟类,但人们对这种疾病在人群层面的后果仍知之甚少。为了解决这个问题,我们整理了 2020 年之前 野生鸟类 人群中发生 HPAI 大规模 死亡率 的 40 个历史病例的人口计数和 死亡率 数据。我们根据 i) 从 暴发 之前的最后一次计数到 暴发 后的第一次计数的人口计数初始变化,ii) 长期来描述这些 暴发 的局部影响平均人口数量的变化,iii) 人口趋势的变化,以及 iv) 恢复到 暴发 之前基线所需的时间。暴发 后,大多数情况下观察到初始种群数量下降,中位下降 17%(四分位数范围 -35% 至 5%)。然而从长远来看,40 个案例中只有 8 个案例发现平均人口数量显着减少,只有 2 个案例人口趋势显着下降。总体而言,暴发 对大多数当地人口造成的影响要么是对人口数量的有限影响,要么是短期减少后又恢复。然而,在 25% 的病例 (10/40) 中,初始下降在监测期内(初始 暴发 后 4-17 年)并未恢复。海鸥和燕鸥最初的下降更为明显。然而,对当地居民的一系列分类单元都产生了影响。鉴于自 2020 年以来 HPAI 的影响规模发生了巨大变化,我们的研究结果支持需要将疾病 暴发 与有效的种群监测相结合,以便识别受正在进行的 暴发 影响的物种。还需要进一步研究来确定尽量减少高致病性禽流感影响的策略,并了解限制受影响人群恢复的因素。

title: Emerging Technologies and Artificial Intelligence for Avian Influenza: Transmission Dynamics, Interspecies Spread, and Early Warning
abstract: Avian influenza remains a major global threat. It causes recurring outbreaks, economic losses, and public health concerns. Avian influenza virus (AIV) circulates naturally in wild waterfowl. Recent outbreaks have raised concerns about viral evolution and cross-species transmission. Infections in mammals, including dairy cattle and humans, highlight the need for stronger surveillance. This integrative narrative review examines AIV epidemiology, viral evolution, host adaptation, and transmission pathways. It gives particular attention to dust and aerosol exposure. It also considers interactions among wild birds, poultry, and mammals. Structured searches of PubMed and Scopus covered the literature from January 2015 to 12 December 2025. Selected 2026 publications provided additional context. The review synthesizes scientific studies, outbreak investigations, and epidemiological reports. It also examines conventional diagnostics and emerging artificial intelligence (AI), molecular, and sensor-based technologies. Current surveillance and biosecurity approaches face challenges in early detection and coordinated response across production settings. AI-enabled monitoring and advanced diagnostics may improve risk assessment, early warning, and outbreak management. However, these technologies require further field validation. Stronger integration of environmental monitoring, data sharing, and established biosecurity practices is needed. A One Health approach can connect animal, human, and environmental surveillance. Such integration may strengthen AIV preparedness and reduce future outbreak risks.

title_zh: 禽流感 的新兴技术和人工智能:传播 动力学、种间传播和早期预警
source_body_en: Avian influenza remains a major global threat. It causes recurring outbreaks, economic losses, and public health concerns. Avian influenza virus (AIV) circulates naturally in wild waterfowl. Recent outbreaks have raised concerns about viral evolution and cross-species transmission. Infections in mammals, including dairy cattle and humans, highlight the need for stronger surveillance. This integrative narrative review examines AIV epidemiology, viral evolution, host adaptation, and transmission pathways. It gives particular attention to dust and aerosol exposure. It also considers interactions among wild birds, poultry, and mammals. Structured searches of PubMed and Scopus covered the literature from January 2015 to 12 December 2025. Selected 2026 publications provided additional context. The review synthesizes scientific studies, outbreak investigations, and epidemiological reports. It also examines conventional diagnostics and emerging artificial intelligence (AI), molecular, and sensor-based technologies. Current surveillance and biosecurity approaches face challenges in early detection and coordinated response across production settings. AI-enabled monitoring and advanced diagnostics may improve risk assessment, early warning, and outbreak management. However, these technologies require further field validation. Stronger integration of environmental monitoring, data sharing, and established biosecurity practices is needed. A One Health approach can connect animal, human, and environmental surveillance. Such integration may strengthen AIV preparedness and reduce future outbreak risks.

title: Factors influencing the timeliness of reporting highly pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks in Europe
abstract: Timely reporting of zoonotic infectious diseases allows for rapid response and mitigation by health authorities. However, little is known about the factors influencing the timeliness of disease outbreak reports. The World Animal Health Information System provides extensive data on delays that arise between first suspecting and subsequently reporting outbreaks of notifiable animal diseases. Here we analysed these report delays using a Bayesian semi-parametric survival model, to assess socio-demographic, epidemiological and cultural covariates on the timeliness of disease outbreak reports in Europe, using highly pathogenic avian influenza as a model disease. The survival model included time-varying coefficients and a penalized spline to account for temporal fluctuations in reporting rates, and parsimonious shrinkage (Bayesian model selection) was obtained using Dirichlet-Laplace priors. The results indicated that outbreaks occurring in wild birds, high outbreak notification rates, country, day of week and national holidays were all associated with delayed outbreak reporting times. Higher political stability and better corruption control, as defined by the World Bank, were also associated with longer reporting times, while high per capita gross national income and local poultry density were associated with shorter reporting delays. Better knowledge of surveillance capacities and modalities on a smaller scale could help further understand the reasons for the associations observed between these factors and reporting delays. Our results can help disease surveillance teams improve predictions of the day-to-day dynamics of epizootics and improve disease-introduction risk assessments. These results may also help inform tailored, country-specific recommendations for health authorities, delivered confidentially through international health organizations, to improve disease reporting.

The World Animal Health Information System provides extensive data on delays that arise between first suspecting and subsequently reporting outbreaks of notifiable animal diseases. Here we analysed these report delays using a Bayesian semi-parametric survival model, to assess socio-demographic, epidemiological and cultural covariates on the timeliness of disease outbreak reports in Europe, using highly pathogenic avian influenza as a model disease. The survival model included time-varying coefficients and a penalized spline to account for temporal fluctuations in reporting rates, and parsimonious shrinkage (Bayesian model selection) was obtained using Dirichlet-Laplace priors. The results indicated that outbreaks occurring in wild birds, high outbreak notification rates, country, day of week and national holidays were all associated with delayed outbreak reporting times. Higher political stability and better corruption control, as defined by the World Bank, were also associated with longer reporting times, while high per capita gross national income and local poultry density were associated with shorter reporting delays. Better knowledge of surveillance capacities and modalities on a smaller scale could help further understand the reasons for the associations observed between these factors and reporting delays. Our results can help disease surveillance teams improve predictions of the day-to-day dynamics of epizootics and improve disease-introduction risk assessments. These results may also help inform tailored, country-specific recommendations for health authorities, delivered confidentially through international health organizations, to improve disease reporting.

title: Genetic diversity of H5 high pathogenicity avian influenza viruses detected in Laos, 2019–2024: multiple clades, subtypes, and genotypes
abstract: Since 2004, H5 high pathogenicity avian influenza viruses (HPAIVs) from several clades have caused outbreaks in Laos, with clade 2.3.2.1e H5N1 viruses predominating since 2015. However, genomic data on H5 HPAIVs circulating in Laos after 2018 remain limited. In this study, we performed whole-genome sequencing of 37 H5Nx HPAIVs isolated in Laos during 2019–2024 and investigated their genetic characteristics using phylogenetic analyses alongside publicly available Lao HPAIV sequences collected during 2015–2024. Based on gene constellations, 12 genotypes were identified across three HA clades: seven clade 2.3.2.1e genotypes (E1–E7), three clade 2.3.4.4b genotypes (B1–B3), and two clade 2.3.4.4h genotypes (H1–H2). Clade 2.3.2.1e H5N1 viruses predominated overall, and novel genotypes emerged through reassortment with 2.3.4.4b H5N1 and Eurasian low-pathogenicity avian influenza (LPAI) viruses. In contrast, 2.3.4.4b H5Nx and 2.3.4.4h H5N6 viruses were detected sporadically. Genetically related 2.3.2.1e H5N1 genotypes co-circulated in Laos, Cambodia, and Vietnam. Clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 viruses detected in 2023 clustered with viruses detected in East Asia and North America since 2021. Genotype H2, a 2.3.4.4h H5N6 virus, was genetically similar to H5N6 viruses epidemiologically linked to a human infection in Laos and detected in poultry and humans in China. In addition, genotype E7 was continuously detected from 2022 to 2024 and had the same gene constellation as viruses associated with human and mammalian infections in Cambodia and Vietnam. These findings demonstrate persistent circulation and reassortment of H5 HPAIVs in Laos, highlighting the need for genomic surveillance to monitor zoonotic risk and transboundary transmission in Southeast Asia.

title_zh: 2019-2024 年老挝检测到的 H5 高致病性 禽流感 病毒的遗传多样性:多个进化枝、亚型和基因型
source_body_en: Since 2004, H5 high pathogenicity avian influenza viruses (HPAIVs) from several clades have caused outbreaks in Laos, with clade 2.3.2.1e H5N1 viruses predominating since 2015. However, genomic data on H5 HPAIVs circulating in Laos after 2018 remain limited. In this study, we performed whole-genome sequencing of 37 H5Nx HPAIVs isolated in Laos during 2019–2024 and investigated their genetic characteristics using phylogenetic analyses alongside publicly available Lao HPAIV sequences collected during 2015–2024. Based on gene constellations, 12 genotypes were identified across three HA clades: seven clade 2.3.2.1e genotypes (E1–E7), three clade 2.3.4.4b genotypes (B1–B3), and two clade 2.3.4.4h genotypes (H1–H2). Clade 2.3.2.1e H5N1 viruses predominated overall, and novel genotypes emerged through reassortment with 2.3.4.4b H5N1 and Eurasian low-pathogenicity avian influenza (LPAI) viruses. In contrast, 2.3.4.4b H5Nx and 2.3.4.4h H5N6 viruses were detected sporadically. Genetically related 2.3.2.1e H5N1 genotypes co-circulated in Laos, Cambodia, and Vietnam. Clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 viruses detected in 2023 clustered with viruses detected in East Asia and North America since 2021. Genotype H2, a 2.3.4.4h H5N6 virus, was genetically similar to H5N6 viruses epidemiologically linked to a human infection in Laos and detected in poultry and humans in China. In addition, genotype E7 was continuously detected from 2022 to 2024 and had the same gene constellation as viruses associated with human and mammalian infections in Cambodia and Vietnam. These findings demonstrate persistent circulation and reassortment of H5 HPAIVs in Laos, highlighting the need for genomic surveillance to monitor zoonotic risk and transboundary transmission in Southeast Asia.
abstract_zh: 自 2004 年以来,来自多个分支的 H5 高致病性 禽流感 病毒 (HPAIV) 在老挝引起了 暴发,其中自 2015 年以来,分支 2.3.2.1e H5N1 病毒占主导地位。然而,2018 年之后在老挝传播的 H5 HPAIV 的基因组数据仍然有限。在这项研究中,我们对 2019-2024 年在老挝分离的 37 个 H5Nx HPAIV 进行了全 基因组 测序,并使用系统发育分析和 2015-2024 年期间收集的公开老挝 HPAIV 序列研究了它们的遗传特征。根据基因星座,在三个HA进化枝中鉴定出12种基因型:七个进化枝2.3.2.1e基因型(E1-E7)、三个进化枝2.3.4.4b基因型(B1-B3)和两个进化枝2.3.4.4h基因型(H1-H2)。进化枝 2.3.2.1e H5N1 病毒总体上占主导地位,通过与 2.3.4.4b H5N1 和欧亚低致病性 禽流感 (LPAI) 病毒重配出现了新的基因型。相比之下,2.3.4.4b H5Nx 和 2.3.4.4h H5N6 病毒是零星检测到的。遗传相关的 2.3.2.1e H5N1 基因型在老挝、柬埔寨和越南共同流行。2023 年检测到的分支 2.3.4.4b H5N1 病毒与 2021 年以来在东亚和北美检测到的病毒聚集在一起。基因型 H2 是一种 2.3.4.4h H5N6 病毒,与在流行病学上与老挝人类感染有关并在中国的家禽和人类中检测到的 H5N6 病毒相似。此外,从2022年至2024年连续检测到E7基因型,其与柬埔寨和越南人类和哺乳动物感染相关的病毒具有相同的基因群。这些发现表明,H5 HPAIV 在老挝持续存在循环和重组,凸显了 基因组监测 监测人畜共患风险和东南亚跨境 传播 的必要性。

title: Antiviral Treatment of Human Influenza A(H5N1) Infection: Treatment Timing, Clinical Outcomes, Virological Outcomes, and Antiviral Resistance: A Systematic Review
abstract: Human influenza A(H5N1) infection remains a clinically important zoonotic disease, but evidence on antiviral effectiveness is limited by observational designs, heterogeneous treatment timing, and potentially overlapping patient populations. This systematic review synthesized evidence on antiviral regimens, treatment timing, clinical and virological outcomes, and antiviral resistance in laboratory-confirmed human A(H5N1) infection. A systematic search of PubMed, Scopus, and ScienceDirect was conducted from database inception to 1 July 2026. Methodological quality was assessed using the Newcastle–Ottawa Scale and the JBI Case Series Checklist. The clinical and methodological characteristics varied across studies; consequently, the findings were synthesized narratively. Potential population overlap was considered when synthesizing findings across publications to avoid duplicate aggregation of patient data. Of 2,329 records identified, 22 publications were included. Oseltamivir treatment was associated with a lower hazard of death than no documented anti-influenza antiviral treatment (adjusted hazard ratio 0.51, 95% confidence interval 0.34–0.77). Treatment within 2 days showed lower odds of death, although the overall estimate was not statistically significant (adjusted odds ratio 0.17, 95% confidence interval 0.03–1.04). Among patients without respiratory failure at treatment initiation, earlier treatment was associated with lower mortality (adjusted odds ratio 0.17, 95% confidence interval 0.03–0.89). Evidence for other antivirals was limited, and one confirmed treatment-emergent H274Y neuraminidase resistance event was identified. Overall, oseltamivir, particularly when initiated early and before advanced respiratory failure, was associated with improved clinical outcomes, although causal inference remains limited by confounding, heterogeneity, and potentially overlapping study populations.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review evaluates the antiviral treatment of human influenza A(H5N1) infection, focusing on treatment timing, clinical and virological outcomes, and resistance development. The review synthesized evidence from 22 publications, highlighting that oseltamivir treatment was associated with reduced mortality, particularly when initiated early and before advanced respiratory failure. However, the findings are limited by observational study designs, heterogeneous treatment timing, and overlapping patient populations, which hinder causal inference. The review also identified one case of treatment-emergent H274Y resistance. While the evidence supports oseltamivir's potential benefits, further research is needed to improve understanding and address the gaps in current knowledge.

The central question is whether antiviral treatment improves outcomes in human H5N1 infection and whether resistance develops.

Methodological quality was assessed using the Newcastle–Ottawa Scale and the JBI Case Series Checklist. The clinical and methodological characteristics varied across studies; consequently, the findings were synthesized narratively. Potential population overlap was considered when synthesizing findings across publications to avoid duplicate aggregation of patient data.
elements_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Oseltamivir treatment was associated with a lower hazard of death than no documented anti-influenza antiviral treatment (adjusted hazard ratio 0.51, 95% confidence interval 0.34–0.77). title_zh: 人类甲型流感 (H5N1) 感染的 抗病毒药物 治疗:治疗 时机、临床结果、病毒学结果和 抗病毒药物 耐药性:系统评价
source_body_en: Human influenza A(H5N1) infection remains a clinically important zoonotic disease, but evidence on antiviral effectiveness is limited by observational designs, heterogeneous treatment timing, and potentially overlapping patient populations. This systematic review synthesized evidence on antiviral regimens, treatment timing, clinical and virological outcomes, and antiviral resistance in laboratory-confirmed human A(H5N1) infection. A systematic search of PubMed, Scopus, and ScienceDirect was conducted from database inception to 1 July 2026. Methodological quality was assessed using the Newcastle–Ottawa Scale and the JBI Case Series Checklist. The clinical and methodological characteristics varied across studies; consequently, the findings were synthesized narratively. Potential population overlap was considered when synthesizing findings across publications to avoid duplicate aggregation of patient data. Of 2,329 records identified, 22 publications were included. Oseltamivir treatment was associated with a lower hazard of death than no documented anti-influenza antiviral treatment (adjusted hazard ratio 0.51, 95% confidence interval 0.34–0.77). Treatment within 2 days showed lower odds of death, although the overall estimate was not statistically significant (adjusted odds ratio 0.17, 95% confidence interval 0.03–1.04). Among patients without respiratory failure at treatment initiation, earlier treatment was associated with lower mortality (adjusted odds ratio 0.17, 95% confidence interval 0.03–0.89). Evidence for other antivirals was limited, and one confirmed treatment-emergent H274Y neuraminidase resistance event was identified. Overall, oseltamivir, particularly when initiated early and before advanced respiratory failure, was associated with improved clinical outcomes, although causal inference remains limited by confounding, heterogeneity, and potentially overlapping study populations.

title: Naturally Occurring PB2 Paired Substitutions Confer Host-Dependent Polymerase Phenotypes in H7N9 Avian Influenza Viruses with Differential ANP32 Support
abstract: H7N9 avian influenza viruses have caused repeated human infections since 2013, but the effects of naturally occurring PB2 substitution combinations on polymerase activity remain poorly understood. We analyzed 899 avian-derived and 1087 human-derived H7N9 PB2 sequences collected between 2013 and 2025. Six PB2 positions (109, 122, 191, 340, 559, and 640) showed distinct frequency changes across epidemic waves and host origins. Pairwise analysis identified five representative combinations with different temporal patterns. In minigenome assays, four paired substitutions reduced polymerase activity in human 293T cells at both 33 °C and 37 °C, whereas none of the five significantly altered activity in chicken DF1 cells at 37 °C or 41 °C. Several paired substitutions showed polymerase activity profiles different from those of the corresponding single substitutions in the tested cellular assays. ANP32 overexpression experiments showed different polymerase activity responses across the tested cellular conditions. Under chicken ANP32A expression, none of the paired-substitution polymerases differed significantly from the wild type, whereas human ANP32A and ANP32B overexpression did not enhance their activity in DF1 cells. Co-immunoprecipitation confirmed detectable interactions between PB2 variants and human or chicken ANP32 proteins. Structural modeling further revealed differences in predicted PB2–ANP32A interfaces among the tested variants. Together, these results show that the tested PB2 substitution combinations produced different polymerase activity profiles in human 293T and chicken DF1 cells and exhibited different responses to ANP32 overexpression under the examined conditions. The findings provide insight into the functional consequences of PB2 evolution during H7N9 circulation.

source_body_en: H7N9 avian influenza viruses have caused repeated human infections since 2013, but the effects of naturally occurring PB2 substitution combinations on polymerase activity remain poorly understood. We analyzed 899 avian-derived and 1087 human-derived H7N9 PB2 sequences collected between 2013 and 2025. Six PB2 positions (109, 122, 191, 340, 559, and 640) showed distinct frequency changes across epidemic waves and host origins. Pairwise analysis identified five representative combinations with different temporal patterns. In minigenome assays, four paired substitutions reduced polymerase activity in human 293T cells at both 33 °C and 37 °C, whereas none of the five significantly altered activity in chicken DF1 cells at 37 °C or 41 °C. Several paired substitutions showed polymerase activity profiles different from those of the corresponding single substitutions in the tested cellular assays. ANP32 overexpression experiments showed different polymerase activity responses across the tested cellular conditions. Under chicken ANP32A expression, none of the paired-substitution polymerases differed significantly from the wild type, whereas human ANP32A and ANP32B overexpression did not enhance their activity in DF1 cells. Co-immunoprecipitation confirmed detectable interactions between PB2 variants and human or chicken ANP32 proteins. Structural modeling further revealed differences in predicted PB2–ANP32A interfaces among the tested variants. Together, these results show that the tested PB2 substitution combinations produced different polymerase activity profiles in human 293T and chicken DF1 cells and exhibited different responses to ANP32 overexpression under the examined conditions. The findings provide insight into the functional consequences of PB2 evolution during H7N9 circulation.

title: Rare recovery of reassortants between contemporary clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 viruses and human influenza A viruses in vitro
abstract: Influenza A virus (IAV) pandemics can arise when animal-derived and human-adapted IAVs exchange genome segments; however, whether contemporary clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 viruses can generate viable reassortants with human IAVs is unclear. Here, we tested the reassortment potential of two clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 viruses with human-adapted H1N1 and H3N2 IAVs using a biosafe reassortment system. Across multiple coinfection conditions, we genotyped 2,698 plaque-purified viral clones and recovered 20 reassortants (0.74%). Polymerase assays identified human IAV subunits, particularly H1N1 PA or H3N2 PB2, that increased H5N1 polymerase activity. Thus, contemporary clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 viruses can reassort with human IAVs, but factors beyond polymerase compatibility may limit their recovery.
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences

title_zh: 现代进化枝 2.3.4.4b H5N1 病毒与人类甲型流感病毒体外重配的罕见恢复
source_body_en: Influenza A virus (IAV) pandemics can arise when animal-derived and human-adapted IAVs exchange genome segments; however, whether contemporary clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 viruses can generate viable reassortants with human IAVs is unclear. Here, we tested the reassortment potential of two clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 viruses with human-adapted H1N1 and H3N2 IAVs using a biosafe reassortment system. Across multiple coinfection conditions, we genotyped 2,698 plaque-purified viral clones and recovered 20 reassortants (0.74%). Polymerase assays identified human IAV subunits, particularly H1N1 PA or H3N2 PB2, that increased H5N1 polymerase activity. Thus, contemporary clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 viruses can reassort with human IAVs, but factors beyond polymerase compatibility may limit their recovery.

title: EVALUATING THE INTERACTION BETWEEN INACTIVATED AVIAN INFLUENZA (H9N2) AND NEWCASTLE DISEASE-INFECTIOUS BRONCHITIS VACCINES IN BROILERS
abstract: This study evaluated how inactivated Newcastle disease (ND) and H9N2 avian influenza (AI) vaccines modify immune responses generated under a live ND-infectious bronchitis (IB) vaccination program in broiler chickens. A total of 150 Ross 308 chicks were assigned to 5 groups. Vaccinated groups received the live respiratory program and differed in their inactivated vaccine exposure: no inactivated vaccine, inactivated ND vaccine, inactivated H9N2 vaccine, or a bivalent inactivated ND-H9N2 vaccine; an unvaccinated group served as the control. Humoral responses were assessed by ELISA and hemagglutination-inhibition assays, cellular responses were evaluated using selected cytokines, and body weight and lymphoid organ indices were monitored. AI ELISA responses showed significant effects of group, age, and their interaction, with the strongest responses occurring in H9N2-vaccinated groups. ND and IB ELISA responses also varied with age and vaccination program, whereas HI testing provided less separation among groups. Cytokine responses were dynamic and age dependent; IL-4 and IL-10 patterns indicated treatment-related Th2/regulatory activity at selected ages, while Th1-associated cytokines showed variable responses. Growth and thymus indices differed among treatments or ages, whereas bursa and spleen indices were less discriminatory. Overall, concurrent inactivated vaccine exposure altered the magnitude and timing of immune responses generated alongside the live ND-IB program, indicating that antigen combination and vaccination timing should be considered when designing broiler vaccination schedules.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated how inactivated Newcastle disease (ND) and H9N2 avian influenza (AI) vaccines affect immune responses in broiler chickens that are also receiving a live ND-infectious bronchitis (IB) vaccination program. The research involved 150 Ross 308 chicks divided into five groups, with varying exposure to inactivated vaccines. Humoral and cellular immune responses were measured using ELISA, hemagglutination-inhibition assays, and cytokine analysis. Results showed that H9N2-vaccinated groups had the strongest AI ELISA responses, while ND and IB responses varied with age and vaccination program. Cytokine patterns indicated Th2/regulatory activity in some groups. The study suggests that antigen combination and vaccination timing should be considered in broiler vaccination schedules. However, the findings are limited by the controlled experimental design and lack of long-term follow-up, resulting in moderate evidence strength.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估灭活新城疫 (ND) 和 H9N2 禽流感 (AI) 疫苗 如何修改肉鸡活 ND 传染性支气管炎 (IB) 疫苗接种 程序下产生的 免疫应答。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 总共 150 只 Ross 308 雏鸡被分配到 5 组,接种组接受实时呼吸计划,其灭活 疫苗 暴露情况有所不同:无灭活 疫苗、灭活 ND 疫苗、灭活 H9N2 疫苗 或二价灭活 ND-H9N2 疫苗;未接种疫苗的组作为对照组。
elements_zh.methods: 通过 ELISA 和血凝抑制测定评估体液反应,使用选定的细胞因子评估细胞反应,并监测体重和淋巴器官指数。
elements_zh.main_results: AI ELISA 反应显示出群体、年龄及其相互作用的显着影响,其中最强的反应发生在 H9N2 疫苗接种组中。ND 和 IB ELISA 反应也随年龄和 疫苗接种 程序而变化,而 HI 测试提供的组间分离较少。细胞因子反应是动态的且依赖于年龄;IL-4 和 IL-10 模式表明 治疗 相关的 Th2/调节活性在选定的年龄,而 Th1 相关细胞因子则表现出不同的反应。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究发现,同时灭活的 疫苗 暴露改变了与实时 ND-IB 程序一起产生的 免疫应答 的幅度和时间,表明在设计肉鸡 疫苗接种 时间表时应考虑抗原组合和 疫苗接种 时间。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,灭活的 疫苗 与活的 ND-IB 程序的组合可能会影响肉鸡中的 免疫应答,这可以为开发更有效的 疫苗接种 控制 禽流感 策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的结果基于受控实验设计,组数和年龄点数量有限,这可能会限制普遍性。由于缺乏长期随访和潜在的混杂因素,证据强度中等。

title: Operationalising Cross-Sectoral One Health Event-Based Surveillance in Albania: A Six-Year Case Study of the Integrated Surveillance Information System
abstract: One Health surveillance requires that information from one sector triggers assessment and action in another. This descriptive case study examines how Albania’s Integrated Surveillance Information System (SISI) operationalised cross-sectoral event-based surveillance (EBS) and what limited routine interoperability, using governance documents, the EBS register of April 2020 to August 2026 and staff surveys. The register held 399 signals, 93 of them animal-health or suspected zoonotic events. Of 363 completed verifications, 255 (70.2%) were substantiated and 41 had a recorded escalation to case notification or outbreak investigation. Veterinary services initiated 26 signals, 20 of 23 with dates registered within two days. After one veterinary brucellosis signal, contact investigation found two confirmed human infections within six days, and avian influenza A(H5N1) signals led to testing of 60 exposed persons, all negative. Human anthrax and brucellosis events were signalled to veterinary services, with an animal source identified in two. Integration was operational at the event level, through reciprocal-signalling rules, shared event records and defined field responsibilities. Routine data remained unjoined, since the veterinary system was unlinked, animal-side actions were unevenly documented, community participation declined and cybersecurity constrained interfaces. Event-level integration can offer a transferable starting point where routine data systems cannot yet be joined.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to explore how Albania's Integrated Surveillance Information System operationalised cross-sectoral event-based surveillance for avian influenza A viruses and to identify factors limiting routine interoperability between sectors.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A descriptive case study was conducted in Albania from April 2020 to August 2026, examining the Integrated Surveillance Information System (SISI) and its implementation across sectors. The study included governance documents, an event register, and staff surveys to assess the system's functionality and challenges.
analysis.methods: The study utilised governance documents, an event register spanning April 2020 to August 2026, and staff surveys to evaluate the operationalisation of cross-sectoral event-based surveillance. It focused on the integration of signals between veterinary and human health sectors.
analysis.main_results: Of 363 completed verifications, 255 (70.2%) were substantiated, and 41 had a recorded escalation to case notification or outbreak investigation. Veterinary services initiated 26 signals, 20 of which were registered within two days.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings demonstrate that event-level integration can function effectively as a starting point for cross-sectoral surveillance, even when routine data systems are not fully interoperable.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study provides insights into the operational feasibility of event-based surveillance systems for avian influenza, offering a model for improving cross-sectoral coordination in public health.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on existing records and staff surveys, which may introduce bias. The evidence is moderate, as it is based on descriptive analysis rather than experimental or longitudinal data.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluates how Albania's Integrated Surveillance Information System (SISI) operationalised cross-sectoral event-based surveillance for avian influenza A viruses. It highlights the system's ability to trigger assessments and actions across sectors, with 70.2% of 363 completed verifications being substantiated. The research demonstrates that event-level integration can serve as a practical starting point for surveillance, even when routine data systems are not fully interoperable. However, the study is limited by its descriptive nature and reliance on existing records, which may affect the strength of its conclusions. The findings suggest that such systems can enhance public health preparedness by improving coordination between veterinary and human health sectors.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨阿尔巴尼亚的综合 监测 信息系统如何针对 禽流感 A 病毒操作基于跨部门事件的 监测,并确定限制部门之间常规互操作性的因素。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2020 年 4 月至 2026 年 8 月在阿尔巴尼亚进行了一项描述性案例研究,研究了综合 监测 信息系统 (SISI) 及其跨部门的实施情况。该研究包括治理文件、事件登记册和员工调查,以评估系统的功能和挑战。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究利用治理文件、2020 年 4 月至 2026 年 8 月的事件登记册以及员工调查来评估基于跨部门事件的 监测 的运作情况。它的重点是兽医和人类健康部门之间的信号整合。
elements_zh.main_results: 在完成的 363 项核查中,255 项 (70.2%) 得到证实,41 项已升级为案件通知或 暴发 调查。兽医部门发出了 26 条信号,其中 20 条在两天内得到登记。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,即使常规数据系统不完全可互操作,事件级集成也可以作为跨部门 监测 的起点有效发挥作用。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究深入探讨了 禽流感 基于事件的 监测 系统的运营可行性,为改善公共卫生领域的跨部门协调提供了模型。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究由于依赖现有记录和员工调查而受到限制,这可能会引入偏差。证据是中等的,因为它是基于描述性分析而不是实验或纵向数据。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨阿尔巴尼亚的综合 监测 信息系统如何针对 禽流感 A 病毒操作基于跨部门事件的 监测,并确定限制部门之间常规互操作性的因素。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 2020 年 4 月至 2026 年 8 月在阿尔巴尼亚进行了一项描述性案例研究,研究了综合 监测 信息系统 (SISI) 及其跨部门的实施情况。该研究包括治理文件、事件登记册和员工调查,以评估系统的功能和挑战。
analysis_zh.methods: 该研究利用治理文件、2020 年 4 月至 2026 年 8 月的事件登记册以及员工调查来评估基于跨部门事件的 监测 的运作情况。它的重点是兽医和人类健康部门之间的信号整合。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在完成的 363 项核查中,255 项 (70.2%) 得到证实,41 项已升级为案件通知或 暴发 调查。兽医部门发出了 26 条信号,其中 20 条在两天内得到登记。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,即使常规数据系统不完全可互操作,事件级集成也可以作为跨部门 监测 的起点有效发挥作用。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究深入探讨了 禽流感 基于事件的 监测 系统的运营可行性,为改善公共卫生领域的跨部门协调提供了模型。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究由于依赖现有记录和员工调查而受到限制,这可能会引入偏差。证据是中等的,因为它是基于描述性分析而不是实验或纵向数据。

title: Whole genome sequences of highly pathogenic H5N1 avian influenza viruses detected in felines in Bangladesh
abstract: ABSTRACT Whole-genome sequences of three highly pathogenic H5N1 avian influenza viruses detected in cats in Bangladesh during 2025–2026 are reported. Phylogenetically, two strains grouped within clade 2.3.2.1a, and the other within the clade 2.3.4.4b. The isolates harbored mutations in key polymerase and HA markers associated with mammalian adaptation and virulence.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to report the whole-genome sequences of highly pathogenic H5N1 avian influenza viruses detected in felines in Bangladesh during 2025–2026, highlighting the potential for cross-species transmission and the need to understand viral evolution in non-traditional hosts.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved the collection and analysis of whole-genome sequences from three highly pathogenic H5N1 avian influenza viruses isolated from cats in Bangladesh between 2025 and 2026. These isolates were compared phylogenetically to other known strains.
analysis.methods: The researchers obtained whole-genome sequences of the H5N1 viruses from infected cats and performed phylogenetic analysis to classify the strains into clades. They also identified mutations in key polymerase and HA markers associated with mammalian adaptation and virulence.
analysis.main_results: Two of the strains grouped within clade 2.3.2.1a, while the third was classified within clade 2.3.4.4b. The isolates were found to harbor mutations in key polymerase and HA markers linked to mammalian adaptation and virulence.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that H5N1 avian influenza viruses can infect and replicate in felines, potentially indicating a broader host range than previously recognized. This adds to the understanding of viral evolution and cross-species transmission.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results contribute to the surveillance of H5N1 in non-traditional hosts, which is critical for assessing the risk of zoonotic transmission and for developing targeted diagnostic and control strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to abstract-level reporting and does not include detailed experimental or clinical data. The evidence is moderate as it is based on phylogenetic classification and mutation analysis without further validation.

analysis.summary_en: This study reports the whole-genome sequences of three highly pathogenic H5N1 avian influenza viruses detected in cats in Bangladesh during 2025–2026. Phylogenetic analysis revealed that two strains grouped within clade 2.3.2.1a, while the third was classified within clade 2.3.4.4b. The isolates exhibited mutations in key polymerase and HA markers associated with mammalian adaptation and virulence. These findings highlight the potential for H5N1 to infect non-traditional hosts like felines, contributing to the understanding of viral evolution and cross-species transmission. The study provides important insights for surveillance and risk assessment but is limited to abstract-level reporting without detailed experimental or clinical data, resulting in moderate evidence strength.

title: Etiopathological Study of Colisepticemia with Coinfection of Low Pathogenic Avian Influenza and Mycoplasma in Broilers
abstract: The present study was conducted to detect Low Pathogenic Avian Influenza (LPAI) and Mycoplasma in 30 broiler flocks (5 birds per flock) showing gross lesions of colisepticemia (Fibrinous pericarditis and perihepatitis) without any significant gross lesion in trachea and bronchi. The study comprised of flock wise mortality, gross and histopathological examination of colisepticemia and molecular identification from pooled sample of trachea for the presence of E. coli, LPAI, Mycoplasma gallisepticum and Mycoplasma synoviae. The mortality among 30 flocks varied between 0.32 and 6.75% with an average of 1.89%. Gross and histopathological lesions were predominantly found in liver, heart, spleen and lungs. All the 30 flocks were found positive for phoA gene of E. coli, whereas 5 (16.60%), 9 (30%) and 4 (13.30%) flocks were positive for H9N2 subtype of Avian influenza virus, i.e. LPAI, Mycoplasma gallisepticum and Mycoplasma synoviae, respectively. Findings of the present study confirmed the concurrent infection of colisepticemia with other primary pathogens such as LPAI, M. gallisepticum and M. synoviae, which indicate that Escherichia coli is a major secondary opportunistic pathogen in a respiratory disease complex of chicken.
journal: The Indian journal of veterinary sciences and biotechnology

title_zh: 低致病性禽流感与支原体混合感染肉鸡败血症病原学研究
source_body_en: The present study was conducted to detect Low Pathogenic Avian Influenza (LPAI) and Mycoplasma in 30 broiler flocks (5 birds per flock) showing gross lesions of colisepticemia (Fibrinous pericarditis and perihepatitis) without any significant gross lesion in trachea and bronchi. The study comprised of flock wise mortality, gross and histopathological examination of colisepticemia and molecular identification from pooled sample of trachea for the presence of E. coli, LPAI, Mycoplasma gallisepticum and Mycoplasma synoviae. The mortality among 30 flocks varied between 0.32 and 6.75% with an average of 1.89%. Gross and histopathological lesions were predominantly found in liver, heart, spleen and lungs. All the 30 flocks were found positive for phoA gene of E. coli, whereas 5 (16.60%), 9 (30%) and 4 (13.30%) flocks were positive for H9N2 subtype of Avian influenza virus, i.e. LPAI, Mycoplasma gallisepticum and Mycoplasma synoviae, respectively. Findings of the present study confirmed the concurrent infection of colisepticemia with other primary pathogens such as LPAI, M. gallisepticum and M. synoviae, which indicate that Escherichia coli is a major secondary opportunistic pathogen in a respiratory disease complex of chicken.

title: Short-term associations between wild-bird and mammalian high pathogenic avian influenza detection in the United States
abstract: High pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) detections in mammals have raised concern about repeated wildlife spillover and the targeting of mammalian surveillance. We evaluated whether wild-bird detection records contained short-term explanatory and predictive information about mammalian detections in the United States. Public surveillance records from April 2022 to July 2026 comprised 18,523 wild-bird and 815 mammalian detections. Monthly state-level mammalian counts were analysed using negative-binomial mixed models adjusted for seasonality, preceding mammalian detections and state-level heterogeneity. The selected model contained contemporaneous and one-month-lagged same-state wild-bird counts. A doubling of one plus the contemporaneous wild-bird count was associated with a 57.9% increase in the expected mammalian count (95% CI 43.5-73.8%), and a doubling of the preceding-month count with a 15.9% increase (5.2-27.8%). Bordering-state exposure did not improve fit. In a six-month temporal holdout, adding same-state wild-bird exposure reduced mean absolute error by 23.8% and root mean squared error by 27.9%, although total detections remained overpredicted. After exact-row deduplication, the corresponding effects were 59.7% and 13.3%. Wild-bird surveillance records contained short-term, geographically local information about mammalian HPAI detection activity, but the associations do not establish direct transmission and require further calibration before operational forecasting.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在解决对野生动物 跨物种溢出 高致病性 禽流感 (HPAI) 重复出现的担忧以及对哺乳动物 监测 的需求。研究问题集中在野鸟检测记录是否可以提供有关美国哺乳动物高致病性禽流感检测的短期解释和预测信息。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究评估了 2022 年 4 月至 2026 年 7 月美国各地野生鸟类和哺乳动物 HPAI 检测记录。它包括 18,523 种野生鸟类和 815 种哺乳动物检测,分析重点是州级数据和时间模式。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员使用负二项式混合模型来分析每月州级哺乳动物计数,并根据季节性、先前的哺乳动物检测和州级异质性进行调整。该模型纳入了同一州的同期和滞后一个月的野生鸟类计数。
elements_zh.main_results: 当期野鸟数量加倍与预期哺乳动物数量增加 57.9% 相关(95% CI 43.5-73.8%),上个月野鸟数量加倍与预期哺乳动物数量增加 15.9% 相关(95% CI 5.2-27.8%)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,野鸟 传播 记录包含有关哺乳动物 HPAI 检测活动的短期、地理本地信息,但这些关联并未建立直接的 传播,需要进一步校准以进行业务预测。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果对于改进 监测 策略和了解 HPAI 跨物种溢出 的动态具有重要意义,这有助于风险评估和有针对性的监测工作。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性包括边界状态暴露并没有改善模型拟合,并且总检测量仍然被高估。证据强度中等,因为这些关联在操作使用之前需要进一步校准。

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在解决对野生动物 跨物种溢出 高致病性 禽流感 (HPAI) 重复出现的担忧以及对哺乳动物 监测 的需求。该研究旨在评估野鸟检测记录是否可以提供有关美国哺乳动物高致病性禽流感检测的短期解释和预测信息。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究分析了 2022 年 4 月至 2026 年 7 月的公开 监测 记录,其中包括 18,523 种野生鸟类和 815 种哺乳动物的检测。重点是州级哺乳动物计数及其与野鸟检测数据的关联。
elements_zh.methods: 使用负二项式混合模型对每月州级哺乳动物计数进行分析,该模型考虑了季节性、先前的哺乳动物检测和州级异质性。该模型纳入了同期和滞后一个月的同州野生鸟类数量。
elements_zh.main_results: 当期野鸟数量加倍与预期哺乳动物数量增加 57.9% 相关(95% CI 43.5-73.8%),上个月野鸟数量加倍与预期哺乳动物数量增加 15.9% 相关(95% CI 5.2-27.8%)。在为期 6 个月的时间坚持中,尽管总检测量仍然被高估,但增加相同州野生鸟类的暴露使平均绝对误差降低了 23.8%,均方根误差降低了 27.9%。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,野鸟 监测 记录包含有关哺乳动物 HPAI 检测活动的短期、地理本地信息。然而,协会并没有建立直接的传播,并且需要在业务预测之前进行进一步校准。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可以通过强调野生鸟类检测数据对哺乳动物 HPAI 活动的潜在预测价值,为 监测 策略提供信息。这可能有助于风险评估和有针对性的监测工作。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的证据受到 监测 记录的使用以及总检测结果可能过度预测的限制。由于这些限制和进一步校准的需要,研究结果的可信度中等。

title: Penetration of avian and human influenza A viruses through mucus gel networks in vitro
abstract: Abstract Influenza A viruses (IAVs) remain a public-health concern because of their continuous evolution and zoonotic transmission. Respiratory mucus is the first extracellular barrier encountered by inhaled viruses, yet standardized approaches for studying influenza virus passage through mucus and the infectivity of transferred virus populations remain limited. Here, we established an in vitro virus–mucus penetration assay to analyze IAV interactions with standardized mucin-containing matrices. We used mucus from human Calu-3 airway epithelial cells cultured under air–liquid interface conditions and bovine submaxillary mucin as surrogate matrices. Preparations were normalized by total protein and characterized using biochemical and biophysical methods. We compared a human seasonal H1N1pdm virus with a highly-pathogenic avian H5N1 virus. Viral genome transfer was quantified by RT-qPCR, while retained infectivity was assessed in susceptible cells. Both mucin-containing matrices restricted viral passage compared with control solutions. Viral RNA transfer and retained infectivity varied by matrix and virus, although no statistically significant difference between H1N1pdm and H5N1 was detected within either matrix. Together, these results establish a framework integrating mucus characterization with complementary measurements of viral transfer and infectivity. This approach provides a basis for investigating influenza virus–mucus interactions under controlled conditions and can be extended to other IAV strains and physiologically relevant mucus sources.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 甲型流感病毒 (IAV) 因其连续的 进化 和人畜共患的 传播 仍然是一个公共卫生问题。本研究旨在调查 IAV 通过呼吸道粘液的传播情况以及转移病毒群体的感染性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 建立了体外病毒-粘液渗透试验来分析 IAV 与标准化含粘蛋白基质的相互作用。该研究使用人 Calu-3 气道上皮细胞的粘液和牛颌下粘蛋白作为替代基质。它将人类季节性 H1N1pdm 病毒与高致病性禽 H5N1 病毒进行了比较。
elements_zh.methods: 我们建立了体外病毒-粘液渗透试验来分析 IAV 与标准化含粘蛋白基质的相互作用。通过总蛋白对制剂进行标准化,并使用生化和生物物理方法进行表征。通过 RT-qPCR 对病毒 基因组 转移进行定量,同时评估易感细胞中保留的感染性。
elements_zh.main_results: 与对照溶液相比,两种含有粘蛋白的基质都限制了病毒的通过。病毒 RNA 转移和保留感染性因基质和病毒而异,但在任一基质内均未检测到 H1N1pdm 和 H5N1 之间存在统计学上的显着差异。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些结果建立了一个将粘液特征与病毒转移和感染性的补充测量相结合的框架。该方法为在受控条件下研究流感病毒-粘液相互作用提供了基础,并且可以扩展到其他 IAV 毒株和生理相关的粘液来源。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为开发更有效的 监测 和流感病毒诊断方法提供信息,特别是在了解它们与呼吸道粘液的相互作用方面。这可能有助于设计有针对性的干预措施来预防病毒 传播。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于体外条件,并未考虑体内因素。证据是温和的,因为它为未来的研究提供了框架,但没有提供关于现实世界中病毒行为的明确结论。

title: Metagenomic assessment of airborne and surface viral signals and worker acceptability during a partial-lid intervention in a Cambodian live bird market
abstract: Abstract Mechanical defeathering can disperse viral material in live poultry markets, but interventional machine modifications must fit routine work. This nonrandomized field study evaluated partial lids on defeathering machines at Orussey Market, Cambodia, across six sampling days, three with lids and three without. Targeted RT-qPCR and target-enriched metagenomics characterised viral RNA in air samples collected during a three-hour air-sampling period and in nearby surface samples collected before and after that period, while work questionnaires assessed usability. Sequencing detected 73 poultry-associated viral taxa. Influenza A virus, avian coronavirus and rotavirus G together accounted for over 80% of relative metagenomic abundance in 14 of 18 air samples. In air samples, RT-qPCR cycle thresholds correlated inversely with metagenomic relative abundance for avian influenza virus and Newcastle disease virus (Spearman’s ρ = −0.645 and − 0.684, respectively). Airborne richness was descriptively lower on days with lids, but targeted viral detections did not change consistently, and composition profiles overlapped. Surface profiles changed from before to after the air-sampling period on days with and without lids; the study did not establish a lid-associated difference in these changes. All five workers reported discomfort and perceived slower work; none wanted to use the lid in its tested form, although three would continue if it were permanently integrated into the machine. With only three sampling days per condition, the study did not establish a consistent reduction in airborne or surface viral contamination associated with lid use. Future studies should evaluate lids redesigned with workers alongside complementary measures addressing ventilation, hygiene, and clean water and waste management to reduce occupational exposure.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to assess the impact of partial-lid modifications on airborne and surface viral signals in live bird markets, addressing the need to reduce viral dispersion during mechanical defeathering while maintaining worker acceptability.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A nonrandomized field study was conducted at Orussey Market, Cambodia, over six sampling days, with three days featuring partial lids on defeathering machines and three days without. Air and surface samples were collected during a three-hour period, and worker questionnaires were used to evaluate usability.
analysis.methods: Targeted RT-qPCR and target-enriched metagenomics were used to characterise viral RNA in air and surface samples. Air samples were collected during a three-hour air-sampling period, while surface samples were collected before and after this period. Work questionnaires assessed worker acceptability and perceived changes in workflow.
analysis.main_results: Sequencing detected 73 poultry-associated viral taxa. Influenza A virus, avian coronavirus, and rotavirus G together accounted for over 80% of relative metagenomic abundance in 14 of 18 air samples. Airborne richness was descriptively lower on days with lids, but targeted viral detections did not change consistently, and composition profiles overlapped.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that the partial-lid intervention may have reduced airborne viral richness, but the lack of consistent changes in targeted viral detections suggests that further studies are needed to confirm its effectiveness. This study provides novel insights into the potential impact of machine modifications on viral dispersion in live bird markets.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that modifying defeathering machines with partial lids could be a potential strategy for reducing airborne viral signals in live bird markets, which may inform future interventions to improve occupational safety and reduce zoonotic transmission risks.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study had only three sampling days per condition, which limits the ability to establish a consistent reduction in airborne or surface viral contamination associated with lid use. The evidence strength is moderate due to the limited sample size and the descriptive nature of the findings.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the impact of partial-lid modifications on airborne and surface viral signals in a Cambodian live bird market during mechanical defeathering. The nonrandomized field study collected air and surface samples over six days, three with lids and three without, and used RT-qPCR and metagenomics to characterise viral RNA. Results showed that airborne richness was descriptively lower on days with lids, but targeted viral detections did not change consistently, and composition profiles overlapped. Worker questionnaires indicated discomfort and slower work with the lid, though some workers would use it if permanently integrated. The study highlights the potential of machine modifications to reduce viral dispersion but notes limitations due to the small number of sampling days. These findings may inform future interventions to improve occupational safety and reduce zoonotic transmission risks in live bird markets.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估活禽市场中部分盖子修改对空气传播和表面病毒信号的影响,解决在机械拔毛过程中减少病毒传播的需要,同时保持工人的可接受性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在柬埔寨奥鲁西市场进行了一项非随机实地研究,为期六个采样日,其中三天在脱毛机上部分盖上盖子,三天没有盖上盖子。在三小时内收集空气和表面样本,并使用工人问卷来评估可用性。
elements_zh.methods: 使用靶向 RT-qPCR 和目标富集宏基因组学来表征空气和表面样本中的病毒 RNA。空气样本是在三小时的空气采样期内收集的,而表面样本是在此期间之前和之后收集的。工作调查问卷评估了员工的可接受性和感知的工作流程变化。
elements_zh.main_results: 测序检测到 73 个家禽相关病毒类群。在 18 个空气样本中的 14 个中,甲型流感病毒、禽冠状病毒和 G 轮状病毒合计占相对宏基因组丰度的 80% 以上。在戴盖子的日子里,空气中的丰富度明显较低,但目标病毒检测并没有一致变化,而且成分分布重叠。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,部分眼睑干预可能降低了空气传播的病毒丰富度,但目标病毒检测缺乏一致的变化表明需要进一步研究来证实其有效性。这项研究为机器改造对活禽市场病毒传播的潜在影响提供了新的见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,改造带有部分盖子的脱毛机可能是减少活禽市场中空气传播病毒信号的潜在策略,这可能为未来改善职业安全和减少人畜共患 传播 风险的干预措施提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究每种情况只有三天的采样时间,这限制了持续减少与盖子使用相关的空气或表面病毒污染的能力。由于样本量有限和研究结果的描述性,证据强度中等。

abstract_zh: 摘要 机械脱毛可以分散活禽市场中的病毒物质,但介入性机器改造必须适合日常工作。这项非随机实地研究评估了柬埔寨奥鲁西市场脱毛机的部分盖子,为期六个采样日,其中三个有盖子,三个没有盖子。靶向 RT-qPCR 和目标富集宏基因组学对三小时空气采样期间收集的空气样本以及该时间之前和之后收集的附近表面样本中的病毒 RNA 进行了表征,同时工作问卷评估了可用性。测序检测到 73 个家禽相关病毒类群。在 18 个空气样本中的 14 个中,甲型流感病毒、禽冠状病毒和轮状病毒 G 合计占相对宏基因组丰度的 80% 以上。在空气样本中,RT-qPCR 循环阈值与 禽流感 病毒和新城疫病毒的宏基因组相对丰度呈负相关(Spearman ρ 分别 = -0.645 和 -0.684)。在戴盖子的日子里,空气中的丰富度明显较低,但目标病毒检测并没有一致变化,而且成分分布重叠。在有盖和无盖的日子里,空气采样期之前和之后的表面轮廓发生了变化;该研究并未确定这些变化与眼睑相关的差异。所有五名工人均表示感到不适并认为工作速度较慢;没有人愿意使用经过测试的盖子,但如果将其永久集成到机器中,则有三个人会继续使用。由于每种情况仅采样三天,该研究并未确定与盖子使用相关的空气传播或表面病毒污染的持续减少。未来的研究应该评估与工人一起重新设计的盖子,以及解决通风、卫生、清洁水和废物管理的补充措施,以减少职业接触。

title: Limited Detection of Influenza A Antibodies in Sandhill Cranes (Antigone canadensis) Wintering in the California Central Valley, USA
abstract: The emergence of clade 2.3.4.4b highly pathogenic H5N1 has led to unprecedented mortality events in crane populations globally. Despite increasing concern, little is known about the prevalence of influenza A virus (IAV) and resulting antibodies in Sandhill Cranes (Antigone canadensis). To address this knowledge gap, we sampled 31 Greater and two Lesser Sandhill Cranes (Antigone canadensis tabida and Antigone canadensis canadensis, respectively) wintering in California’s Central Valley during the 2023–2024 and 2024–2025 seasons to assess active infection with IAV. None of the sampled individuals tested positive for infection with IAV via rRT-qPCR. We also sampled 29 Greater and two Lesser Sandhill Cranes for serological evidence of prior exposure to IAV; four Greater Sandhill Cranes tested positive for IAV antibodies via bELISA and antibodies specific to H5 were detected in two individuals. These findings suggest prior exposure, potentially on breeding grounds where crane mortalities related to highly pathogenic H5 have been documented. However, the low seroprevalence observed in this study suggests that the Staten Island, California, wintering population may remain largely vulnerable to future outbreaks, though small sample size does limit the broader applicability of these findings.

The research was motivated by the emergence of clade 2.3.4.4b highly pathogenic H5N1, which has caused significant mortality in crane populations. The study collected samples from 31 Greater and two Lesser Sandhill Cranes during the 2023–2024 and 2024–2025 seasons. abstract_zh: 进化枝 2.3.4.4b 高致病性 H5N1 的出现导致全球鹤种群中出现前所未有的 死亡率 事件。尽管人们越来越关注,但人们对甲型流感病毒 (IAV) 的 患病率 以及沙丘鹤 (Antigone canadensis) 中产生的抗体知之甚少。为了弥补这一知识差距,我们对 2023-2024 年和 2024-2025 年季节在加利福尼亚州中央谷越冬的 31 只大沙丘鹤和两只小沙丘鹤(分别是 Antigone canadensis tabida 和 Antigone canadensis canadensis)进行了采样,以评估 IAV 的活跃感染情况。通过 rRT-qPCR 检测,所有采样个体均未检测出 IAV 感染呈阳性。我们还对 29 只大沙丘鹤和两只小沙丘鹤进行了采样,以获取之前接触过 IAV 的血清学证据;通过 bELISA,四只大沙丘鹤的 IAV 抗体检测呈阳性,其中两只个体中检测到了 H5 特异性抗体。这些发现表明,之前曾接触过,可能是在繁殖地,那里有与高致病性 H5 相关的鹤死亡记录。然而,本研究中观察到的低 血清流行率 表明,加利福尼亚州斯塔滕岛的越冬种群可能仍然在很大程度上容易受到未来 暴发 的影响,尽管小样本量确实限制了这些发现的更广泛的适用性。

title: BSP3, a bursal-derived tetrapeptide, promotes avian B lymphocyte proliferation in vitro and enhances antigen-specific antibody responses in mice
abstract: The bursa of Fabricius is a unique central immune organ in avian species, and bioactive peptides derived from this organ play important roles in immunomodulation. However, the identification of novel, structurally simple peptides and their underlying molecular mechanisms remains to be fully elucidated. In this study, a novel tetrapeptide, designated BSP3 (bursal-derived small peptide 3; Leu-Leu-Pro-Gly, LLPG), with a molecular weight of 398.50 (m/z), was isolated from the bursa of Fabricius of White-feathered broiler chickens and identified by high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC) and matrix-assisted laser desorption/ionization time-of-flight tandem mass spectrometry (MALDI-TOF-MS/MS); its sequence uniqueness was confirmed by BLASTP analysis. In vivo experiments in mice showed that co-immunization with BSP3 and an inactivated H9 subtype avian influenza virus vaccine significantly enhanced serum antigen-specific IgG responses, promoted IFN-γ and IL-4 secretion, and increased antigen-stimulated splenic lymphocyte proliferation. In vitro , BSP3 promoted the proliferation of the chicken B lymphocyte line DT40 at an optimal concentration of 5 μg/mL. Exploratory transcriptome analysis of BSP3-treated DT40 cells identified 1,100 candidate genes with altered expression, which were annotated to RNA processing, actin crosslink formation, and extracellular matrix organization; MAPK signaling was positioned at the core of the pathway interaction network. RT-qPCR validation was consistent with the transcriptome data. In conclusion, BSP3 is a novel bursa-derived tetrapeptide that shows immunomodulatory activity in mice and in avian B cells. Further validation in avian hosts and functional protection studies are warranted before BSP3 can be considered a candidate vaccine adjuvant.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to explore the immunomodulatory potential of bioactive peptides derived from the bursa of Fabricius in avian species, as these peptides are known to play important roles in immunomodulation.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved in vitro experiments using the chicken B lymphocyte line DT40 and in vivo experiments in mice, where BSP3 was co-immunized with an inactivated H9 subtype avian influenza virus vaccine.
analysis.methods: BSP3 was isolated from the bursa of Fabricius of White-feathered broiler chickens using high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC) and matrix-assisted laser desorption/ionization time-of-flight tandem mass spectrometry (MALDI-TOF-MS/MS). Its sequence uniqueness was confirmed by BLASTP analysis. In vitro, its effect on B lymphocyte proliferation was tested at an optimal concentration of 5 μg/mL. In vivo, its impact on antigen-specific antibody responses was evaluated through co-immunization with an inactivated H9 subtype avian influenza virus vaccine.
analysis.main_results: In vivo experiments showed that co-immunization with BSP3 and an inactivated H9 subtype avian influenza virus vaccine significantly enhanced serum antigen-specific IgG responses, promoted IFN-γ and IL-4 secretion, and increased antigen-stimulated splenic lymphocyte proliferation.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted BSP3 as a novel bursa-derived tetrapeptide with immunomodulatory activity in both mice and avian B cells, highlighting its potential as a candidate vaccine adjuvant.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that BSP3 could be a promising candidate for enhancing vaccine efficacy against avian influenza viruses, potentially improving immunological responses in both avian and mammalian hosts.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to in vitro and in vivo experiments in mice, and further validation in avian hosts is needed to confirm its potential as a vaccine adjuvant. The evidence is moderate due to the experimental nature of the findings.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the immunomodulatory effects of a novel tetrapeptide, BSP3, derived from the bursa of Fabricius of White-feathered broiler chickens. In vitro experiments demonstrate that BSP3 promotes the proliferation of chicken B lymphocytes at an optimal concentration of 5 μg/mL. In vivo experiments in mice show that co-immunization with BSP3 and an inactivated H9 subtype avian influenza virus vaccine significantly enhances antigen-specific IgG responses, increases IFN-γ and IL-4 secretion, and promotes splenic lymphocyte proliferation. The authors interpret these findings as evidence of BSP3's potential as a vaccine adjuvant, though further validation in avian hosts is required. The study's results suggest that BSP3 could be a valuable tool for improving immunological responses against avian influenza viruses, with moderate evidence strength due to its experimental design.

title: TLR5 signaling amplifies airway epithelial cell responses to influenza through a MyD88–JAK1 crosstalk
abstract: Abstract Influenza vaccines and antivirals are compromised by viral evolution, underscoring the need for host-directed strategies that provide broad, strain-independent protection. While flagellin, a Toll-like receptor 5 (TLR5) agonist, has an established role in shielding against respiratory bacterial infection, its role in shaping antiviral defenses in the airway epithelium remains poorly understood. Using porcine bronchial epithelial cells and pigs infected with swine influenza A virus (SIAV), we show that TLR5 activation sensitizes cells to type I interferon (IFN). Flagellin lowered the IFN concentration required for STAT2 activation, amplifying interferon-stimulated gene expression, and suppressing viral replication. This effect required IFN signaling and MyD88, and coincided with a flagellin-induced MyD88–JAK1 interaction. In SIAV-infected pigs, a single administration of flagellin was sufficient to heighten IFN responsiveness and to mitigate disease severity. These findings reveal a novel crosstalk between TLR5 and IFN pathways, offering a strain-independent route to boost antiviral protection.

abstract: Spillover of influenza A(H5N1) virus to cattle in the United States sparked global concern.
